visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand with fair skin holds a black smartphone vertically against a backdrop of a white wall and a light-colored wooden table. The phone's screen displays a video of a girl in a kitchen setting, and bright yellow subtitles appear at the bottom of the screen. (2) A young woman with long black hair and pink highlights sits at a wooden desk in a well-lit office studio. She wears a white lace sleeveless top and a black skirt. Behind her, a pegboard holds photos, and several small potted cacti sit on the desk. (3) An off-screen hand reaches into the frame to pass another smartphone to the main girl. She accepts it with a smile, holding both devices as she looks at the camera. Her facial expressions are animated, and the room's lighting is bright and even. (4) A tight close-up shot focuses on a smartphone screen showing a camera viewfinder. A yellow flower icon suddenly appears in the lower corner as the device is moved closer to a green plant, indicating that the automatic macro focus mode has been triggered. (5) The camera focuses on the rear of a light green iPhone with dual lenses. A shimmering graphic effect highlights the bottom lens while the girl's finger points to it. The background is slightly blurred, maintaining focus on the physical hardware of the phone. (6) The scene cuts back to the girl at the desk. She holds both phones and continues her conversation with the off-camera person. Her expression shifts from confident explanation to a playful, slightly defensive look as she realizes the "magic" is being debunked by her companion. (7) A final cut shows a different girl with short dark hair and large Sony headphones around her neck. She is in a cluttered office environment and stares directly into the camera lens with a deadpan, unimpressed expression, creating a humorous concluding reaction shot.
